text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, I'm walking around the<n>academy after
class has let out.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh my... Yet another victory. You're<n>good at this, Sei.

text_block_list.name: Defeated Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! I can't believe this! I wanted to<n>be the one to
break your winning<n>streak...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hahaha. Who's next?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello, Trainer. It's a card game<n>we're playing.
Sei is unbeatable.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I've been mesmerized watching her<n>blend mind
games with her sound<n>tactics.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Want to try for yourself? There's<n>time to kill before
dinner anyway.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I get destroyed...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! Rematch? I'm always up for<n>more.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: In that case, let me offer my support.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
While observing Sei's winning streak,<n>I've learned
a thing or two about her<n>tendencies.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And from my experience in other<n>games, I find that
the presence of a<n>supporter can often be the key to
achieving victory.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Two on one? Sounds fun to me.<n>Maybe that way
you'll actually give<n>me a challenge.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Then let's have a fair contest.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Try applying pressure with this card,<n>Trainer.
Depending on her reaction,<n>we can infer—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sure, sure. I already saw that coming.<n>♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Unlike my first try, we put up a decent<n>fight but
come up just short in the<n>end.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whew... You had me sweating for a<n>second there.
Not bad, guys, not bad.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Anyway, time's been killed, so I'm<n>headed for din—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: One more round, please.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There's enough time for one more<n>before dinner,
yes?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Come, let's start the next match at<n>once. You'll
need to focus if you<n>don't want to lose.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
What luck, a good hand. Let's take<n>full advantage
of it and strike fear into<n>her heart.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You're playing that card now?Seriously?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. After all, you can't attack right<n>now, can you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ahhh?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
She's defenseless. Trigger a trap<n>with that tactics
card to keep her in<n>place. Then, we launch an all-out
assault.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer. Keep the cards<n>coming. No
hesitations.
choice_data_list: You're the best supporter I could ask for.
You're the best supporter I could ask for.

A-are you sure you're a supporter? Not a front-line
warrior?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer. Keep the cards<n>coming. No
hesitations.
choice_data_list: You're the best supporter I could ask for.
You're the best supporter I could ask for.

A-are you sure you're a supporter? Not a front-line
warrior?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm honored to hear you say so. I'll<n>continue with
my support, then.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Our storybook ending is nigh. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... I should've let sleeping dogs<n>lie...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We put our heads together and, after<n>a hard-fought
battle, come away with<n>a win!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm a supporter, silly. Think<n>of me as
your tactician.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now, the enemy is out of options. If<n>we play our
cards right, we can stay<n>on the offensive all the
way to victory.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Guh!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Keep up the pressure. Pedal to the<n>metal, go go! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We ramp up the attack to eleven,<n>securing a
hard-fought victory!
